params.name: origin
params.description: The origin (source) video URL appended as the request path.

params.name: w
params.description: Target video width in pixels (greater than 100).

params.name: h
params.description: Target video height in pixels (greater than 100).

params.name: func
params.description: Resize function applied when both width and height are provided.

params.name: bg_color
params.description: Background (padding) color used with func=fit (hex code or color name).

params.name: bg_img_fit
params.description: Use a blurred version of the video for the background/padding when set to 1.

items.docs: On-the-fly video processing and transcoding using the same URL model as images. Input is limited to 500 MB, up to 4K, and the first 60 seconds.
